run_stanford_cars_handler: run the stanford_cars_handler function to load and split the Stanford Cars dataset from a given path
parse_labels_annotations: parse MATLAB annotation arrays into a filename to label ID dictionary using _parse_labels
generate_car_images: generate PIL image and label pairs from the car images tar archive using the gen function
review_LABELS: review the 196 car class labels list to understand available classification categories
download_stanford_cars_dataset: download the Stanford Cars dataset using the stanford_cars_dataset DownloadableArtefact URLs and checksums
